capture_compatibility.lineage_is_not_evidence: Capture compatibility is NOT established by two commits belonging to a declared lineage, by a permitted-commit list, or by any ancestry relation. No commit is enumerated by this document.
capture_compatibility.principle: A raw capture produced under predecessor full commit P may participate in a successor processing campaign S only if its capture-critical closure is EQUAL to the cohort's authorized closure. Full repository source-commit equality is NOT required, and is NOT sufficient on its own either.
required_conditions: same scientific manifest identity and inventory
same authority identity required for capture
same target rows and path identity
same capture runtime and apparatus identities
capture-time recorded source digests agree with the capture commit

capture_critical_closure.derivation: Call-graph reachability over first-party definitions, seeded at the Stage-2 capture DRIVER entrypoints, digesting the exact source text of each reachable definition plus each capture-critical file's executable module prologue.
capture_critical_closure.governance_scope_projection: A reachable component whose only capture-time effect is to say WHICH source paths pre-outcome provenance must already have verified is digested by its capture-relevant PROJECTION -- the subset naming capture-critical paths -- not by its literal bytes. Lengthening the governed list strengthens verification of files that cannot change a frame; dropping a capture-critical path from it changes the projection and blocks.
capture_critical_closure.import_time_side_effect_soundness: Every file that is import-reachable but not call-reachable is asserted by test to have a definition-only module body, so a module doing real work at import time is forced into governance rather than pruned.
capture_critical_closure.unbounded_module_handle_rule: A module the capture path holds as a module OBJECT rather than by an imported name contributes ALL of its definitions, because name resolution cannot bound which of them execute. This is why the live campaign runtime -- reached as a returned module from p2_common.load_live and stored on CaptureSession.live -- is governed in full. The escalation is conservative: it can only add components.
capture_critical_closure.why_definitions_not_files: development_workflow holds both derive_effective_capture_spec, which decides the seed, frame count, speed and start position a capture runs under, and DurableController, which cannot touch a captured byte. Digesting whole files would make an edit to the second indistinguishable from an edit to the first and report a changed capture apparatus when no capture-determining component had changed -- a false BLOCKED that would force recollection of valid measurements.
capture_critical_closure.why_not_module_import_closure: The transitive module-import closure of the capture entrypoint is 60 files and contains p2d_extract, p2e_analyze, the model adapter, the activation hooks and the ridge implementation, because p3_run_sequential binds those names at module scope while the capture path uses only derive_artifacts from it. Adopting it would make the capture and processing closures nearly identical and every downstream repair would fail capture compatibility -- not because a frame could change, but because Python binds names at module scope.
capture_critical_closure.why_the_driver_and_not_the_launcher: The capture is produced by stage_unit_driver in its own process. The launching controller decides only WHETHER a unit runs; the driver re-derives and re-verifies its authority, manifest, stage binding, authorization, provenance and unit identity through require_capture_authorization before capturing anything, and refuses on any disagreement. A launcher therefore cannot change what a capture records or the identity it records itself under.

cohort_reporting.scientific_compatibility_fact: all admitted capture-critical closures are equal to one value

immutable_capture_evidence.principle: A completed raw capture remains permanently bound to the exact source, runtime, manifest, authorization and provenance under which it was actually captured. A later downstream software repair MUST NOT rewrite it.

no_provenance_laundering.enforcement: Both commits are recorded as separate fields and the equality claim is recomputed from them, so a hand-set boolean cannot carry it.
no_provenance_laundering.principle: A downstream processor MUST NOT claim capture_source_commit == processing_source_commit unless they actually are equal.

processing_provenance.principle: Processing provenance is bound separately, to the exact successor source and runtime that produce activations, readouts and derived evidence.

reason_for_decision: A frozen DOWNSTREAM identity defect requires a successor processing freeze after a valid raw source capture already exists. No Stage-2 decoder outcome has been computed, exposed or consulted.

recollection.if_capture_critical_closure_differs: Reuse is FORBIDDEN and the pipeline STOPS for authority review. Automatic recollection is forbidden, because recapturing would destroy the evidence that the apparatus had changed.
